async def act(page):
    # Search for the 'thoughtbot/administrate' project using the searchbox
    searchbox = page.get_by_role('searchbox', name='Filter by name')
    await searchbox.fill('thoughtbot/administrate')
    await searchbox.press('Enter')
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Click the project link; use exact match for the project name
    project_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='thoughtbot/administrate', exact=True)
    await project_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Navigate to the Repository tab; assuming it's a link with name 'Repository'
    repo_tab = page.get_by_role('link', name='Repository')
    await repo_tab.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Extract commit author names; GitLab commit items often have author links with '@' symbol
    commit_author_links = page.get_by_role('link').filter(has_text='@')
    author_texts = await commit_author_links.all_text_contents()
    # Count commits per author
    from collections import Counter
    author_counts = Counter(author_texts)
    most_common_author, most_commits = author_counts.most_common(1)[0]
    # Return the author with the most commits
    return most_common_author
